description: MMS gate: run the inline esm-spec 6.6 tests of problems/advection_1d_nonuniform_dirichlet.esm (model Advection, test mms_advdiff_nonuniform_dirichlet) at the problem's default resolution (N=64) through each binding's official simulation pathway. Exercises the centered nonuniform first-derivative rule central_D1_nonuniform_dirichlet_bc (the rule under test, advective term) alongside the conservative Dirichlet Laplacian central_D2_nonuniform_dirichlet_bc (diffusive, stabilizing term) on the quadratic-stretch mesh, with the exact unforced advection-diffusion mode e^{2x} + e^{-lambda t} e^{x} sin(pi x) and inhomogeneous shared walls gL=1, gR=e^2; the x-shaped geometry observeds xc and dxw are re-derived from N. The assertions and their tolerances live in the problem file itself; this manifest only routes the runners.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
